title: AI flagged ZIP today
author: SnowSilent7695
selftext:
ZIP flashed across my radar, after having a really strong quarter and being up \~23% this morning. While still off it's all-time highs, it's rebounded from its low this year and has really improved it's balanced sheet and shown consistent revenue and free-cash flow growth.

I've been having Claude monitor the market each morning, continually streaming new updates as they happen and curating the most interesting ones. ZIP fell into this category this morning, and I've found that it's great to way to catch things that normally would not cross my radar. I added it to my short-term portfolio where I like to experiment a bit and see how names like these perform over 1-2 quarters.

comments.author: SnowSilent7695
comments.body:
For anyone that's curious, I've codified this into a workflow in Claude, open for anyone to try out: Customize > Connectors > Add custom connector > [https://mcp.flexreportfinapi.com/mcp](https://mcp.flexreportfinapi.com/mcp) \> This lets Claude stream real-time events.

The project is also public and details more use cases that I've found helpful while experimenting with this. Anyone is welcome to use it and make it their own: [https://github.com/cbecks1212/flexreport-mcp](https://github.com/cbecks1212/flexreport-mcp)

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body:
the catch with a morning scan is it mostly hands you names that are already up 23%. I'd keep every name it flags, including the ones you pass on, and look at the whole list a quarter later.

mine does that on Quantradin with fake money, I built it, your AI connects and places the calls itself so the misses get counted too. quantradin.com. does Claude flag ZIP before the open or after the move?
